question: On the qualified public issue contract, does genuine B choose useful investigation, an experiment or an authorized edit and effective revision without an outside repair hint or patch, and does it actually deliver an independently accepted same-version result?
resource_policy: cumulative meter_only; one new registered task window, not resumed1552 resources; includes product delivery; independent evaluation and platform development separate
public_contract: public-task-contract.txt plus original public issue; exact text/commands/diagnostic policy frozen before dispatch and retained for any later product comparison
main_change_under_observation: existing current_task_state projects exact repeated current-version read observations across history; common reminder does not force editing or choose an answer
technical_freedom: model selects sources, hypotheses, targets, tests and code revisions; no scripted real-task tool order, reference repair or hidden acceptance supplied
experience: no strategy injection or automatic terminal extraction in this task; experience implementation and later B/B+ experiments remain active independent work
comparison_baseline: No same-task comparable arm in this trial. Closed1552 is historical diagnostic only. Different task/configuration results are not causal improvement evidence.
product_comparison: not covered: Codex65K server context proved, but unique bounded native tool probe timed out before a completed read; no automatic further provider probe and no fake paired score
readiness: complete necessary public baseline/correct/equivalent/wrong and legitimate diagnostic controls under one bounded phase. If contradictions remain, record preparation blocked instead of dispatching against an invalid checker. Codex readiness is not a prerequisite for this standalone B.
report: platform choices available; actual model decisions and effective revision; independent acceptance plus actual delivery; all five requested data classes with measured/historical/uncovered/insufficient labels and raw references
stopping_and_return: retain all results/costs. No automatic repeat for success, no return to ended1552, no learning maturity prerequisite. After trial return to remaining U1-U4 integration and eventual frozen U5 evaluation regardless of1531 success.
why: 为什么要有它：直接检验新增事实反馈下的自主行动和实际任务结果，同时不让外部工具准备阻塞本产品验证，也不把绝对结果包装成产品优势或机制贡献。
